2026-11-10 slice: nine on-air setup tiles (pattern, minutes, warm-up, ambient, bell tone, interval, end bell) moved to choiceTileClasses and seven Journey v2 controls (drip, target and settings tiles, difficulty and format pills, pillar pill, official flag) to chipClasses or choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 162 to 146. Idle tiles gain the kit's bg-surface and selected pills the kit's solid-ink chip, by design. About 146 sites remain, mostly admin (28) and bespoke controls whose bg-primary-bg tint matches the lexical counter; the row stays open.

2026-11-10 slice 3: the Space branding form's seven selectable tiles (logo backdrop, hero height, button orientation, scrim, look, theme, soon-state theme) moved to choiceTileClasses; raw-button-bg 146 to 139. Active tiles are disabled, so each keeps disabled:opacity-100 over the kit's disabled dimming. About 139 sites remain.
